zeus.name: Zeus
zeus.story: Youngest son of Cronus, hidden as a baby so his father could not swallow him. Grown, he freed his siblings, overthrew the Titans with thunderbolts forged by the Cyclopes, and took the sky as his share of the world.
zeus.trivia: Homer calls him the cloud-gatherer, and shows him shaking the aegis to stir up storms.

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
thunderbolt.description: Strikes the enemy for {damage}% of attack, with a {chance}% chance to stun.

aegis-storm.name: Aegis Storm
aegis-storm.description: Shakes the aegis over the field: every enemy takes {damage}% of attack.

king-of-olympus.name: King of Olympus
king-of-olympus.description: At the start of battle, all allies gain {amount}% attack.

achilles.name: Achilles
achilles.story: Son of the sea nymph Thetis and the mortal Peleus, the greatest fighter of the Greeks at Troy. He withdrew from the war in anger at Agamemnon and returned only after Hector killed his friend Patroclus.
achilles.trivia: The story of his mother dipping him in the Styx comes from a later poet, Statius, not from Homer.

spear-of-pelion.name: Spear of Pelion
spear-of-pelion.description: Strikes the enemy for {damage}% of attack.

wrath.name: Wrath
wrath.description: Gains {amount}% attack, then strikes for {damage}% of attack.

dipped-in-styx.name: Dipped in the Styx
dipped-in-styx.description: When badly wounded, gains a shield worth {shield}% of health.

patroclus.name: Patroclus
patroclus.story: Achilles' closest friend. While Achilles refused to fight, Patroclus put on his armor to drive the Trojans back from the ships, pushed on toward the walls of Troy and was killed by Hector.
patroclus.trivia: The funeral games Achilles held for him fill most of a book of the Iliad.

borrowed-armor.name: Borrowed Armor
borrowed-armor.description: Gains a shield worth {shield}% of health and {amount}% defense.

loyal-friend.name: Loyal Friend
loyal-friend.description: Each turn, heals the most wounded ally for {heal}% of attack.

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.story: The only mortal among the three Gorgon sisters, whose gaze turned onlookers to stone. Perseus beheaded her by watching her reflection in a polished shield.
medusa.trivia: Hesiod says the winged horse Pegasus sprang from her body when she died.

stone-gaze.name: Stone Gaze
stone-gaze.description: Strikes for {damage}% of attack with a {chance}% chance to stun.

hall-of-statues.name: Hall of Statues
hall-of-statues.description: Slows every enemy by {amount}% and strikes them for {damage}% of attack.

serpent-hair.name: Serpent Hair
serpent-hair.description: Gains {energy} energy each time she is hit.

gaia.name: Gaia
gaia.story: One of the first beings to emerge after Chaos. She bore the starry sky, the mountains and the sea, and from her union with the sky came the Titans.
gaia.trivia: She helped hide the infant Zeus from Cronus on Crete.

bountiful-earth.name: Bountiful Earth
bountiful-earth.description: Heals every ally for {heal}% of attack.

mother-of-all.name: Mother of All
mother-of-all.description: Heals every ally for {heal}% of attack and shields them for {shield}% of health.

deep-roots.name: Deep Roots
deep-roots.description: At the start of battle, gains {amount}% defense.

first-born.name: First Born
first-born.description: Each turn, heals every ally for {heal}% of attack.

thor.name: Thor
thor.story: Son of Odin and protector of gods and people against the giants. He carries the hammer Mjölnir, iron gloves to hold it and a belt that doubles his strength.
thor.source: Poetic Edda, Thrymskvida; Snorri Sturluson, Prose Edda
thor.trivia: When a giant stole his hammer, Thor got it back by going to the wedding disguised as the bride.

hammer-throw.name: Hammer Throw
hammer-throw.description: Strikes the enemy for {damage}% of attack.

thunder-over-midgard.name: Thunder over Midgard
thunder-over-midgard.description: Every enemy takes {damage}% of attack, with a {chance}% chance to stun.

belt-of-strength.name: Belt of Strength
belt-of-strength.description: At the start of battle, gains {amount}% attack.

odin.name: Odin
odin.story: Chief of the Aesir, who gave an eye for a drink from the well of wisdom and hung nine nights on the world tree to win the runes. Two ravens fly out each day and bring him news of the world.
odin.source: Poetic Edda, Hávamál and Grímnismál; Snorri Sturluson, Prose Edda
odin.trivia: His ravens are named Huginn and Muninn, thought and memory.

ravens-report.name: Ravens' Report
ravens-report.description: Strikes the weakest enemy for {damage}% of attack.

gungnir.name: Gungnir
gungnir.description: Hurls the spear that never misses: {damage}% of attack to one enemy.

all-father.name: All-Father
all-father.description: At the start of battle, every ally gains {energy} energy.

fenrir.name: Fenrir
fenrir.story: A wolf born of Loki who grew so fast the gods feared him. They bound him with a fetter made by dwarves from impossible things, and the god Tyr lost his hand in the wolf's jaws as surety.
fenrir.trivia: Gleipnir was made from the sound of a cat's footsteps, a woman's beard and the roots of a mountain, among other things.

savage-bite.name: Savage Bite
savage-bite.description: Strikes for {damage}% of attack and lowers the target's defense by {amount}%.

breaking-gleipnir.name: Breaking Gleipnir
breaking-gleipnir.description: Gains {amount}% attack and speed for {turns} turns.

ymir.name: Ymir
ymir.story: The first being, formed where the ice of Niflheim met the sparks of Muspelheim. Odin and his brothers killed him and made the world from his body: earth from his flesh, sea from his blood, sky from his skull.
ymir.source: Snorri Sturluson, Prose Edda, Gylfaginning; Poetic Edda, Völuspá
ymir.trivia: He was fed by a primeval cow, Audhumla, who licked the first god out of the salty ice.

rime-breath.name: Rime Breath
rime-breath.description: Every enemy takes {damage}% of attack and is slowed by {amount}%.

world-from-flesh.name: World from Flesh
world-from-flesh.description: Shields every ally for {shield}% of health and raises their defense by {amount}%.

frost-giant.name: Frost Giant
frost-giant.description: At the start of battle, gains a shield worth {shield}% of health.

ra.name: Ra
ra.story: The sun god who sails across the sky by day and through the underworld by night, reborn each dawn. On the night journey he must defeat the serpent Apep to rise again.
ra.trivia: His day boat and night boat had different names: Mandjet and Mesektet.

solar-barque.name: Solar Barque
solar-barque.description: Strikes for {damage}% of attack and burns for {burn}% of attack each turn.

noon-blaze.name: Noon Blaze
noon-blaze.description: Every enemy takes {damage}% of attack and burns for {burn}% of attack each turn.

daily-rebirth.name: Daily Rebirth
daily-rebirth.description: Each turn, heals for {heal}% of attack.

anubis.name: Anubis
anubis.story: The jackal-headed guardian of burials and embalming. In the hall of judgment he weighs the heart of the dead against the feather of Maat.
anubis.trivia: Jackals prowled the desert cemeteries, which may be why the guardian of the dead took their shape.

weighing-of-the-heart.name: Weighing of the Heart
weighing-of-the-heart.description: Strikes the weakest enemy for {damage}% of attack.

guide-of-souls.name: Guide of Souls
guide-of-souls.description: Heals every ally for {heal}% of attack and raises defense by {amount}%.

embalmer.name: Embalmer
embalmer.description: When an ally is badly wounded, shields them for {shield}% of health.

apep.name: Apep
apep.story: A vast serpent of darkness who attacks the boat of the sun every night. He is driven back again and again, but never destroyed for good.
apep.source: Book of the Dead, spells 7 and 39
apep.trivia: Priests wrote his name on papyrus and burned it as a ritual to keep him away.

coils-of-chaos.name: Coils of Chaos
coils-of-chaos.description: Strikes for {damage}% of attack with a {chance}% chance to stun.

swallow-the-sun.name: Swallow the Sun
swallow-the-sun.description: Lowers every enemy's attack by {amount}% and strikes them for {damage}% of attack.

endless-return.name: Endless Return
endless-return.description: When badly wounded, heals for {heal}% of attack.

gilgamesh.name: Gilgamesh
gilgamesh.story: A proud king who found a true friend in Enkidu. Together they killed Humbaba, guardian of the cedar forest. After Enkidu died, Gilgamesh searched the world for a way to escape death.
gilgamesh.trivia: The epic describes him as two-thirds god and one-third man.

axe-of-heroes.name: Axe of Heroes
axe-of-heroes.description: Strikes the enemy for {damage}% of attack.

cedar-forest.name: Cedar Forest
cedar-forest.description: Strikes for {damage}% of attack and lowers the target's defense by {amount}%.

two-thirds-divine.name: Two-thirds Divine
two-thirds-divine.description: At the start of battle, gains {amount}% health.

enkidu.name: Enkidu
enkidu.story: Shaped from clay by the goddess Aruru to be a match for Gilgamesh. He lived among the animals until he came to Uruk, fought the king, and became his brother.
enkidu.trivia: Before he came to the city, he freed animals from hunters' traps.

wild-strength.name: Wild Strength
wild-strength.description: Strikes the enemy for {damage}% of attack.

brother-in-arms.name: Brother in Arms
brother-in-arms.description: Heals the most wounded ally for {heal}% of attack and raises their attack by {amount}%.

tiamat.name: Tiamat
tiamat.story: The primeval salt waters, mother of the first gods. When the younger gods killed her consort, she raised an army of eleven monsters. Marduk defeated her and split her body to make the sky and the earth.
tiamat.trivia: The Tigris and the Euphrates were said to flow from her eyes.

eleven-monsters.name: Eleven Monsters
eleven-monsters.description: Every enemy takes {damage}% of attack and loses {amount}% defense.

mother-of-depths.name: Mother of the Depths
mother-of-depths.description: Gains {energy} energy each time she is hit.

cu-chulainn.name: Cú Chulainn
cu-chulainn.story: As a boy he killed the fierce hound of the smith Culann and offered to guard the house in its place, which gave him his name. Alone, he held the border of Ulster against the army of Connacht.
cu-chulainn.trivia: In battle a frenzy could twist his body out of human shape.

gae-bolg.name: Gáe Bulg
gae-bolg.description: Strikes the enemy for {damage}% of attack.

battle-frenzy.name: Battle Frenzy
battle-frenzy.description: Gains {amount}% attack for {turns} turns, but lowers his own defense.

hound-of-culann.name: Hound of Culann
hound-of-culann.description: Each time he is hit, gains {amount}% attack.

morrigan.name: The Morrígan
morrigan.story: A goddess of battle and prophecy who appears as a crow over the field. When Cú Chulainn refused her, she attacked him in the shapes of an eel, a wolf and a heifer.
morrigan.source: Táin Bó Cúailnge; Cath Maige Tuired
morrigan.trivia: After the second battle of Mag Tuired she spoke a prophecy of the end of the world.

crow-over-the-field.name: Crow over the Field
crow-over-the-field.description: Lowers every enemy's attack by {amount}% for {turns} turns.

prophecy-of-doom.name: Prophecy of Doom
prophecy-of-doom.description: Every enemy takes {damage}% of attack, with a {chance}% chance to stun.

yamata-no-orochi.name: Yamata no Orochi
yamata-no-orochi.story: A serpent with eight heads and eight tails, so long it stretched over eight valleys. The storm god Susanoo made it drunk on strong sake and cut it apart, finding a sword in one of its tails.
yamata-no-orochi.trivia: Moss and trees grew on its back.

valley-of-eight.name: Over Eight Valleys
valley-of-eight.description: Every enemy takes {damage}% of attack and burns for {burn}% of attack each turn.

eight-tails.name: Eight Tails
eight-tails.description: At the start of battle, gains a shield worth {shield}% of health.

kappa.name: Kappa
kappa.story: A water spirit of rivers and ponds that pulls the careless under. It keeps water in a dish on top of its head, and loses its strength if the water spills.
kappa.trivia: Kappa are said to be very polite: bow to one and it bows back, spilling its water.

river-pull.name: River Pull
river-pull.description: Strikes for {damage}% of attack and slows the target by {amount}%.

polite-bow.name: Polite Bow
polite-bow.description: Heals for {heal}% of attack and gains a shield worth {shield}% of health.

water-dish.name: Water Dish
water-dish.description: At the start of battle, gains {amount}% defense.

sun-wukong.name: Sun Wukong
sun-wukong.story: A monkey born from a stone egg on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit. He learned magic, wrecked the heavenly court, was trapped under a mountain for five hundred years, and later guarded a monk on his journey west.
sun-wukong.trivia: His staff can shrink to the size of a needle, which he keeps behind his ear.

ruyi-staff.name: Ruyi Staff
ruyi-staff.description: Strikes the enemy for {damage}% of attack.

seventy-two-forms.name: Seventy-two Forms
seventy-two-forms.description: Every enemy takes {damage}% of attack, with a {chance}% chance to stun.

born-of-stone.name: Born of Stone
born-of-stone.description: At the start of battle, gains {amount}% speed.
